items.title: LUCKI is hurt in a fight with Playboi Carti's entourage at ComplexCon
items.summary: An altercation between LUCKI's and Playboi Carti's entourages at ComplexCon left LUCKI with a laceration, and video of him being hustled into his car spread within minutes. "LUCKI" was the No. 2 trend in the US that night, with "Carti" close behind. "Clear footage of Playboi Carti sprinting to his car for safety" (18K) became the meme, and LAPD was reported to be investigating it as an attempted murder with four victims.
items.author: @DailyLoud
